changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO medical_degree (clinic_id, name) SELECT c.id, d.name FROM clinic c CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 'MBChB' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'MMSc' UNION ALL SELECT 'PhD' UNION ALL SELECT 'DSc' UNION ALL SELECT 'MPH' UNION ALL SELECT 'DGO' UNION ALL SELECT 'DCH' UNION ALL SELECT 'DA' UNION ALL SELECT 'DPM' UNION ALL SELECT 'DLO' UNION ALL SELECT 'DOMS' UNION ALL SELECT 'DDVL' UNION ALL SELECT 'DTCD' UNION ALL SELECT 'DDPH' UNION ALL SELECT 'DipDiab' UNION ALL SELECT 'DipDerm' UNION ALL SELECT 'DNB Family Medicine' UNION ALL SELECT 'FNB' UNION ALL SELECT 'FRACP' UNION ALL SELECT 'FCCP' UNION ALL SELECT 'MNAMS' ) d WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM medical_degree md WHERE md.clinic_id = c.id AND LOWER(md.name) = LOWER(d.name) );
